R.rate_note: illustrative: SE_diff is the X12-X08 pair's; at gate time the T* vs own-p2a SE_diff is used. Each statistic's margin >= 3 SE_diff, so each rate <= Phi(-3) = 0.00135. FAST/FAST loss is counted under the p3a side22 floor (proxy p2a). WATCH statistics are not summed.

inputs.calibration: R and drift reused from Task 4's 0-kg Walk-Play calibration (thresholds v1.2)

implementation_notes: es3 stamps are read with the es1 line ids (payload_read.level_reads reads env seeds 1-2 only; the es1 and es2 line values are asserted identical before the relabel).

The tracking carve-out at an es3 seed uses max(|drift es1|, |drift es2|) (thresholds.json has no es3 drift); it needs the in-pin reference's seed-K stamp, and no reference runs es3, so an es3 tracking line is read absolute. Likewise the L135 shared-capability-limit rule needs the reference's same seed and is absent at es3.

Near-line (es3) needs exactly ONE failing line key over es1 + es2 (the CHARTER's 'its only failing or knife-edge line'), every failing value inside its knife-edge band, and a roll / pitch miss on one seed only.

EXTEND's 'only stress cells fail, on completion or survival' = every failing S line is field_light_completion or survival.<c> (an h_meas / turn_fc / tracking / roll / pitch miss makes it FAIL-STRESS).

DR null (TDR x0.7 - old < m, so TCTL never runs): FAIL-REGRESSION if N or R fails, else UNATTRIBUTED if S passes (no attribution possible), else FAIL-STRESS noted 'DR null' (the dose audit precedes recording it).

A pending es3 / relaunch is resolved by enumeration: when every outcome of the pending cells gives the same verdict, that verdict stands; otherwise PENDING-ES3 / RELAUNCH-DUE, or UNRESOLVED once the 4 cell-seed allowance is exceeded. The allowance is per GATE: the post-EXTEND G1 read also counts the pre-EXTEND TDR's es3 cell-seeds (read g1 --extended --prior-tdr), and a G2 class-ambiguity relaunch is charged as one 4 cell-seed block per ambiguous cell from the moment it is due (a half-finished relaunch is not double-counted).
The bridge and G2 relaunches use the gate name + '_RL'; the first launch stays the in-pin reference.
A row whose stamp fails the checks twice (two launches) stops the queue (decide-record-notify).

The shared L000 rows (TDR's / old T*'s L000 nominal = the suite@1/2 + field_light@1/2 selection / 0-kg rows) run with the cell composition (no TP_STRIP_KEYS); every refused runner key is absent from p3b.env / p3b.field_light.env (checked), so the strip is a no-op and the rows are identical.

G2's cross-pin R WATCH track_err line = select_student.tracking_watch (|ratio - 1|, +0.05) of the pick vs c28000's Task 4 full block; completion rows flag below c28000 - m (completion_pairs, m = max(0.05, 2 SE)).
